s01167.summary: Solene prepares at a speed-climbing wall, then climbs and slightly misses the record.
A tape of her younger self advises her to breathe and race yesterday's Solene.
She climbs again, breathes at the third hold, and beats the record.

s00748.summary: Archibald phones Hortense from the opposing tower, smugly claiming her account.
He holds up the reorganisation binder and announces she now reports to him.
Hortense writes I RESIGN, shows it through the window, and leaves.

s00730.summary: Old Orrin enters his late friend's abandoned wizard library.
He reads a letter saying the lonely book will open only for him.
The book glows and turns its pages as Orrin sits down to read.

s01818.summary: A rancher and granddaughter meet a wandering priest in a ruined mission courtyard.
Caleb explains he came to scatter his wife's ashes where they married.
The priest blesses the scattering and the ashes drift into the last light.

s02391.summary: Engaged couple sample wedding cakes, quickly choosing almond and lemon.
Theo admits he only wanted the excuse to watch Gabriel choose.
Gabriel presses lemon cake into his own face; the chef deadpans.

s01137.summary: Posing as tourists, Suki and Moses discuss their plan to steal a rare orchid.
The gardener Ulrich reveals he knows their plan and that the orchid isn't the last.
Ulrich offers a real cutting if they leave the blue pot, and leads them on.

s01629.summary: Five people barricade a telegraph office as a stampede shakes the floor.
The telegraph repeats hold, and a voice like dead Tommy calls from outside.
They brace with weapons as the roar rises, then passes and the key says all clear.

s00758.summary: Staff begin an MRI scan on elderly patient Eustace Quinn.
The image shows it is not a tumour and the radiologists smile.
The magnet yanks his ring and the table; they halt it and free him.

s02273.summary: On a ferry bocce court, Tonino accuses brother-in-law Marcello of nudging the pallino.
Luca measures Marcello closer; Tonino knocks Marcello's bowl into the sea.

s02034.summary: At the championship's last frame, Marcel needs a spare while Gert scowls.
His throw leaves three pins; Gert smirks.
Marcel hurls the ball in rage and it ricochets to topple the standing pins.
They laugh, the throw counts, and rivals Gert and Marcel shake hands.

s01337.summary: A medium opens a seance in a lighthouse parlor as the table knocks.
The Commodore asks if dead Edmund is present; Lady Miriam begs him to stop.
The candle lies flat and Miriam walks out onto the gallery.
Madame tells Theodora she never said Miriam was her mother.

s00158_0.summary: A canvas dentist tent on a muddy hill advertises teeth pulled for two dollars.

s00342.summary: Nonna and Big Walt clash on a bocce court over whose ball is closer.
Darius measures for Nonna, and she shares her espresso thermos with Walt.

s00269.summary: A bloodied woman joins an armed man in a freight elevator.
She searches his folio, finds a false identity, and demands his real name.
The lights die and they scuffle; she pins him by the throat.
He is her brother Stefan; she slaps then hugs him after eleven years.

s00446.summary: An agent escorts a scientist with a cuffed briefcase down an elevator.
A janitor draws a blade from his mop and Solomon beats him in the dark.
In the lobby Solomon uncuffs the briefcase, hands it over, and walks out.

s02454.summary: At a funeral reception, Dorothea bosses siblings preparing food in the basement kitchen.
Dorothea blames Stanley for not helping with bills or their mother's illness.
Rosalind stops the fight; they recall Mama loved a fight and carry dishes up.

s00664.summary: On a rooftop, Cassidy admits she left prom after being mocked about her dress.
Eli stays with her, jokes about roofs, and holds her hand.
His phone shows 14 missed calls; they scuffle over it and she makes him say he's glad.
Eli ignores the phone and they dance to a scratchy waltz.

s02139.summary: Drifter Jubal watches the door at a salt works while the deputy questions his business.
Bounty hunter Belle enters and lays a wanted poster before Jubal.
Jubal claims the poster hides a judge's cover-up; the seal confirms Garrity's signature.
Belle sits to eat stew, rifle on her knees, as the four share a wary silence.

s00824.summary: On her last day, Odalys plays an old cassette in the empty ferry ticket booth.
Her younger voice recites the schedule and calls it a good job; she pockets the stamp and closes up.

s02128.summary: Family and staff gather in a clockmaker's shop for the reading of the will.
The Brandt clock is bequeathed to its keeper, but Teddy says it stopped and its weights were taken.
Mireille notes Kaspar's too-clean hands; the bequest depends on a working clock.
Mireille pockets the winding key and leaves; Kaspar's new watch has stopped.
Teddy hints she has the weights and leaves; Rossiter will read the will himself.

s00759.summary: Lawyers depose a witness in a funeral home, bickering over objections.
Water floods the exhibits in a tangle of accidents; the director supplies black linens.
They mop up in silence and resume the deposition.

s01974.summary: Dragan demands the bag from Kestrel, who refuses, saying backups protect her.
Inspector Rosalind descends, revealing she wants the bag too, not an arrest.
A voice on the catwalk reveals a listener; Kestrel gives up the bag.
The bag is empty; Kestrel flooded the dry dock to destroy the laptop and walks out.

s01541.summary: Lakshmi challenges a nameless inspector in a seed vault; the station asks for quarantine.
The inspector unhoods, revealing mycelial skin, and calls himself the contamination.
Ambrose asks why they buried his kind and says he wants to grow.
The ring turns green and Lakshmi takes his hand, declaring herself specimen.

s01531_0.summary: Milo teases Zeke about a smudged phone number in a skate park snack shack.
June shouts for a towel; the boys collide in the doorway rushing out.

s01803.summary: Inspector Hester exposes inconsistencies about a second lamp in the observatory.
She notes the moved telescope and warm canvas, suggesting someone was just there.
Clementine admits she lied about being at the cottage because he told her to.
